_doc: Manually curated links/notes pulled from external sources (currently: Instagram @zero2sudo Stories/Highlights). Re-check the source and append new entries here as they appear -- Stories are 24h-ephemeral, so this is a point-in-time snapshot, not a live feed. type is 'link' (real, clickable URL) or 'reference' (useful context with no extractable URL, usually because the source content is a screenshot rather than live HTML).

entries.title: HFT firm poaching more D.E. Shaw hardware specialists
entries.description: eFinancialCareers article on a hardware-engineering hiring trend at HFT/quant firms, surfaced in @zero2sudo's Story alongside a note about ASIC/Design Verification roles opening up at HRT and similar firms.

entries.title: Databricks intern & new-grad interview panel breakdown
entries.description: SWE Intern: Code (60m) -> Algorithms (60m) -> Behavioral (30m). Data Science Intern: DS Code+Fundamentals (60m) -> DS Code -> DS Fundamentals. PM Intern: PRD take-home -> PRD Deep Dive -> Product Deep Dive -> Databricks Deep Dive -> Behavioral (30m). New Grad SWE also includes a Systems Design & Architecture round (60m). Sourced from Databricks' own 'Brickfest' recruiting event, screenshotted -- no direct link, saved as reference for interview prep.

entries.title: Wells Fargo 2025 #ChangeMakers Summit -- recruiting program notes
entries.description: Wells Fargo runs 'Office Hours' every Mon/Thu 1-2pm ET during their ChangeMakers recruiting cycle. Applicants outside the Analytics & Data Program get a take-home assessment via email with a 5-day, non-resettable window. Selection process for the Summit itself runs in the first two weeks of September. Screenshotted email -- no direct application link captured.

entries.title: Tesla resume workshop AT UNC Chapel Hill — Wed Sep 16, 5:00 PM EST
entries.description: Tesla 'Supercharging Your Resume' virtual workshop for UNC Chapel Hill students, Wed Sept 16 at 5:00pm EST (your school — sign up via the Direct Consideration #004 issue). Other campuses: Purdue 9/8, Georgia Tech 9/21, Miami 10/23.

entries.title: Capital One added an 'agentic engineering' interview round
entries.description: Capital One's SWE process now includes a new agentic-engineering round (some reports say it replaced the traditional technical round). Task: connect an API to a frontend or fix a bug using agentic coding tools in JS; lighter version is one AI prompt ('how would you use AI here'). Prepare for both. Relevant: you're applying to Capital One.

entries.title: New 2027 internships opened: Google, SpaceX, Disney, Mastercard, Honeywell +more
entries.description: #004 (Aug 31): SpaceX Spr/Summer 2027 (flexible sites); Google Summer 2027 BS/MS SWE (US+Canada) + PhD research; Disney Spring 2027 CS/CE (Lake Buena Vista); Mastercard SWE intern OA-free (O'Fallon/Arlington/Atlanta/NYC); Honeywell AI/ML + SWE (US citizens only — you qualify); DV Trading, BNY, Freddie Mac, GlossGenius, Zipline, QTS.

entries.title: #003 (Aug 26): NVIDIA, Microsoft, Datadog opened new internships
entries.description: Direct Consideration #003 flagged fresh NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Datadog internship openings.

entries.title: Quant finals (Jane Street, Citadel) are END OF SEPTEMBER — quant recruiting moves early
entries.description: From @zero2sudo Insider Info 5 (1w ago): Jane Street and Citadel quant finals are all at the end of the month; quant recruiting opened back in February. If you're chasing quant/Jane Street, the timeline is much earlier than most expect.

entries.title: Capital One Business Analyst = virtual job tryout + code signal
entries.description: From @zero2sudo Insider Info 4 (2w ago): Cap One BA (same umbrella) is a Virtual Job Tryout — a few work-style questions, then a 'code signal' ~12 questions long with probability + decision-based questions. No score reported; sounds like they opted out of scoring. Know what to expect if you apply.
